modelType: Paired Monte Carlo delivery-resilience stress test
warning: All event rates, delays, costs, and mitigations are illustrative stress assumptions for control design. They are not measured ReHarvest probabilities, Egyptian market forecasts, legal limits, or insurance estimates.

assumptions.pairedComparison: The protected and unprotected operations receive the same random disruptions and severity rolls.

events.label: Fuel or range failure
events.control: Fuel-range gate with 25% reserve and evidence for the primary plus two backups

events.label: Primary truck unavailable
events.control: Three independent, verified truck-driver pairs with response-time confirmation

events.label: Mechanical or electrical failure
events.control: Vehicle-specific pre-trip inspection, defect history, and cargo-transfer playbook

events.label: Tire, brake, or steering defect
events.control: Non-overridable safety inspection gate and verified roadside/backup response

events.label: Driver absent, ill, or fatigued
events.control: Primary and backup driver confirmation, fitness declaration, and acknowledgement expiry

events.label: Supplier or lot not ready
events.control: Expiring supplier readiness confirmation with live lot, quantity, labour, and price evidence

events.label: Pickup gate or access failure
events.control: Verified pin, gate, contact, road access, loading slot, and second contact

events.label: Crates, labour, or loading delay
events.control: Crate count, loading labour, equipment, stack, and maximum-loading-time gate

events.label: Quantity or scale mismatch
events.control: Calibrated pickup/delivery weights, tare controls, display photos, and discrepancy block

events.label: Produce condition deterioration
events.control: Lot-specific condition limits, shade/ventilation, time thresholds, and reinspections

events.label: Closure, restriction, or wrong route
events.control: Verified plan A/B/C, truck restrictions, offline route packet, and revised ETA workflow

events.label: Severe traffic or queue
events.control: Risk-adjusted departure time, live condition check, stop sequence, and time buffer

events.label: Heat, rain, flood, dust, or wind
events.control: Weather thresholds, local confirmation, protective equipment, and reapproval after changes

events.label: Phone, network, or contact failure
events.control: Charged phone, power bank, backup channel/contact, offline packet, and missed-ack escalation

events.label: Buyer receiver or dock not ready
events.control: Expiring buyer readiness confirmation, backup receiver, waiting limit, and diversion option

events.label: Missing or unreliable handoff evidence
events.control: Mandatory typed evidence, quality checks, immutable events, and witnessed exception

events.label: Route cash or payment failure
events.control: Approved route float, dual approval, verified beneficiaries, idempotency, and reconciliation

events.label: Theft, tamper, or personal-safety event
events.control: Safe routes/stops, low cash, seals, check-ins, duress escalation, and cargo quarantine

events.label: Food-safety or traceability incident
events.control: Non-overridable quarantine, recipient trace, recall workflow, and evidence preservation

events.label: App, storage, or integration unavailable
events.control: Numbered offline route packet, visible sync state, idempotency, and reviewed reconciliation

releaseGates: Primary truck plus two independent backup truck-driver pairs confirmed for the exact route window.
Fuel evidence proves route distance, detour allowance, and at least a 25% reserve for all three vehicles.
Safety inspection passes tires, wheels, brakes, steering, lights, mirrors, horn, wipers, spare, jack, and tools.
Engine, cooling, battery, leaks, warning lights, maintenance expiry, registration, insurance, and permits pass.
Cargo bay is clean, dry, pest-free, odour-free, compatible with previous cargo, and inspector-approved.
Payload, crate count, dimensions, axle distribution, stack, airflow, doors, and securement pass.
Primary and backup drivers confirm fitness, qualification, rest, contactability, and route understanding.
Supplier reconfirms exact lot, grade, quantity, price, readiness, labour, documents, gate, and loading window.
Buyer reconfirms receiver and backup, gate, dock, unloading labour, scale, quantity, criteria, price, and payment.
Route packet contains verified pins, plan A/B/C, restrictions, conditions, safe stops, buffer, and offline directions.
Phones, chargers, power banks, airtime/data, backup contacts, offline order packet, and escalation tree pass.
Pickup and delivery weight controls, required photos, signatures, lot/vehicle links, and audit events are ready.
Weather and security conditions remain inside defined thresholds; material changes automatically revoke release.
Route float, toll/fuel methods, deposits, payment recipients, limits, and duplicate-payment controls pass.
Diversion buyer, safe holding point, incident owner, emergency contacts, and cargo-transfer procedure are confirmed.

fuelExample.rule: Never release a delivery with only one truck or an unverified fuel statement.
fuelExample.primaryEvidence: Current gauge and odometer photos, receipt, declared consumption, calculated route plus 25% reserve.
fuelExample.backupRequirement: Two independently verified truck-driver pairs with sufficient capacity, fuel range, hygiene approval, response time, and authority to activate.
fuelExample.automaticBlock: Any missing, stale, inconsistent, or insufficient fuel/capacity evidence blocks dispatch and opens refuel or backup activation.
